$comment: a7-designation/4: per-invocation designation of an FX-02 VERIFY invocation (the verification, its 16.7 reverification, a negative control) or of the A6-7 measurement under the candidate A7-1 round 4 (I-62 A-7, point 2 (c)): it names the role of every custodied artifact of category (c) (at most one artifact per role) and registers its path and its blob; the rebase record (role REBASE, with its RunId registered) only in the reverification (Invocation.Kind REVERIFICATION) and, as its copy, in a negative control with invocation on the inputs of that reverification (Invocation.Kind REVERIFICATION_CONTROL, RAE §10), whose designation identifies the reverification (Source). MainSha_eval is derived (K.MainSha, or the MainAfterSha of the rebase record of the reverification), never designated. Part of the construction and validation procedure that A7-1 point 7 names as invalidator (identified by the SHA-256 of this file).
title: a7-designation/4

Kind.$comment: absent = VERIFY (the verification and the negative controls on its inputs); REVERIFICATION = the 16.7 reverification without conflicts; REVERIFICATION_CONTROL = a negative control with invocation on the inputs of that reverification (RAE §10), with Source; only these two kinds have a REBASE role; MEASUREMENT = the A6-7 measurement invocation, which produces no verification and has no relay facts (no RELAY role)

RunId.$comment: only for the REBASE role, where it is required (checked by the builder and the validator: the JSON-schema subset of the bench has no conditional keywords): the RunId of the rebase record (16.6), the name of its directory; in a REVERIFICATION_CONTROL, the RunId of the record of the reverification, whose copy it is

Control.$comment: the control (RAE §10 nc1-nc3; V14 D.3 N4-N7b), as in its path artifacts/orchestration/<UnitId>/<TaskId>-<control>/

Designation.$comment: the custodied a7-designation/4 of the reverification

Source.$comment: only (and always) for Invocation.Kind REVERIFICATION_CONTROL (checked by the builder and the validator): the reverification whose inputs the control copies
